questions.stem: Which of the following is true about brain death?

options.label: A
options.text: Complete loss of cerebral cortical function but preservation of brainstem reflexes.

options.label: B
options.text: Irreversible loss of all brain function, including the brainstem, with inability to breathe independently.

options.label: C
options.text: Persistent vegetative state where higher brain functions are lost, but spontaneous respiratory effort is present.

options.label: D
options.text: Reversible coma with absence of brainstem reflexes.
